EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - CONSTRUCTION LABOURER
Southern Cross Builders Pty Ltd, Sydney NSW, Australia

Employer: Southern Cross Builders Pty Ltd, ABN 45 123 456 789
Employee: Ramon Dela Cruz, Passport No. P9988776 (Philippines)
Duration: 12 months from the date of arrival, renewable.
Pay: AUD 26.50 per hour, paid weekly by bank transfer.
Hours: the employee may be required to work up to 55 hours a week, including weekends, as directed by the site supervisor.
Passport: the employer will hold the employee's passport and visa documents in the site office for safekeeping for the contract term.
Recruitment: the employee must pay AUD 3,000 in recruitment and placement fees to the agency before the first day of work.
Termination: the employer will give 2 weeks' written notice, or payment in lieu, if ending the contract without cause.
Rest: the employee is entitled to public holidays off, or paid at the penalty rate if asked to work on one.
Governed by the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) and NSW workplace law.

Signed: J. Whitfield (Employer) Ramon Dela Cruz (Employee)
Date: 3 August 2026
